'''Freia Kallea''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] from [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]] who lived during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]]. She was largely responsible for charting and linking the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], the only [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] to span [[The galaxy/Legends|the entire galaxy]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] living around [[3700 BBY/Legends|3700 BBY]], Kallea was one of the first female pilots who decided to map out a part of the galaxy. She managed to blaze a trail beginning at the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and continuing through the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] to the other side, effectively passing through the whole galaxy. Sewing together the [[Dustig Trace]], the [[Sprizen End Run]] and dozens other one-hop routes, she formed a larger hyperway, called the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Opening the galaxy beyond [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] and joining its northern and southern quadrants, the scale of [[Galactic community|galactic civilization]] changed forever.<ref name="IDC" /> In a local level, Brentaal became the only system to be at the intersection of two major hyper-routes (the other being the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]])

After that, Kallea became a symbol of Brentaal's cultural strength and endurance, and her name would pass to posterity. She then retired from the life of a pilot to marry into a Brentaal family.<ref name="IDC" />

Now a noblewoman, Kallea (who retained her maiden name) would work to turn her new family into a major trading enterprise, the [[Kallean League]]. Even years after her death, the Kallean League would still remain a large consortium of representatives of different trading houses.

===Legacy===
[[File:The_Kallea_Cycle.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''[[The Kallea Cycle]]'': [[Vessa Brentioch]] as Freia Kallea and [[Gelod Vothran]] as [[Sival Brentioch]].]]

Over three thousand years after her time, during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kallea's tale would be presented as a five-hour, three-part opera, the ''[[The Kallea Cycle|Kallea Cycle]]'', portraying her life and especially her discovery of the Hydian Way. The Kallea Cycle debuted in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], inside the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the former [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on Coruscant. Its opening was a gala attended by the Coruscanti elite, including [[Miltin Takel|Grand Admiral Takel]]. Later, the Cycle would be performed on Brentaal, particularly in [[Votrad]] stadium, the greatest arena on the planet, as the opera required huge sets.

Shortly after that, Kallea's story was once again adapted, now as a holo-feature produced, directed, and starring [[Neile Janna]]. ''[[Kallea's Hope]]'' was then a format easily understood and accessible to the majority of the people, and some artists of the New Order credit it with restoring interest in Kallea's person and the previous opera.

==Behind the scenes==
Freia Kallea's discovery of the Hydian Way originally took place around [[3000 BBY]], as established in sources such as ''[[Imperial Double-Cross]]'', but was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] to take place before the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="DW">{{Blog|danwallace|146|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 4 of 5)}}</ref>
